# OS-FINALQA: the File rows that need a card with a project open, docs/qa/catalogue/file.md: the export's failure and cancel (QA-FIL-024, QA-FIL-023), DELETE's marker and the
# nothing-erased proof (QA-FIL-032, QA-FIL-042) and PURGE's no-card-call (QA-FIL-039). The card is the scratch copy of the fixture e2e_card (Projects/Small Song, generated by the target
# e2e_card_fixture, never committed), found with --cards. No `snap`: this scenario checks the strip, the card and the model, so it needs no golden.

document
wait 20
card e2e_card
wait 20
audio on
wait 20

# A computer copies the project to a second folder (the card is pulled for the copy), so the DELETE row has a project that is not the open one. The listing is A-Z: Copy first.
card pull
card copy "Projects/Small Song" "Projects/Copy"
card insert
wait 100
tap file
wait 700
assert state screen=FILE sel=Copy

# QA-FIL-032: the first Delete asks in the strip (DELETE COPY? DELETE AGAIN), the second marks the folder: an empty .deleted file and DELETED: COPY (the strip's wording is host-proven,
# file_projects_test; the rescan the mark triggers says READ AGAIN right after).
tap delete
assert state msg=~DELETE_COPY[?]_DELETE_AGAIN
# a cursor move takes the question back: the next press asks again and marks nothing
tap down
tap up
assert state sel=Copy
tap delete
assert state msg=~DELETE_COPY[?]_DELETE_AGAIN
assert file "Projects/Copy/.deleted" absent
tap delete
assert file "Projects/Copy/.deleted" exists
# QA-FIL-042: nothing is erased: the marker is empty and the folder's files are still on the card, byte for byte.
assert file "Projects/Copy/.deleted" size=0
assert file "Projects/Copy/project.o3pj" sha=fe075d31e2849cf6cb81a0bb157e1d748d13ed9c7c9141d98119b51370dc74df
assert file "Projects/Copy/project.o3pj" size=2648
# the name leaves the list at the next read
tap f2
wait 700
assert state screen=FILE sel=Small_Song msg=~READ_AGAIN:_1_ITEM

# Open Small Song for the export and purge rows (a fresh document opens at once, no question).
tap f1
wait 900
assert state screen=PATTERN msg=PROJECT_Small_Song_OPENED
assert model "inst.49.name=Synth A"

# The EXPORT page (F7 on PROJECTS), the cursor on the SONG row.
tap file
wait 100
tap f7
wait 100

# QA-FIL-024: the card full: the export fails with the reason on the strip, the overlay goes, and no file and no folder is left on the card.
card full
tap f1
wait 4000
assert state overlay=NOTIFY msg=~EXPORT_FAILED:_CARD_IS_FULL
assert file "Export" absent
assert file "Export/Small Song/Small Song_Song0001.wav" absent
assert file "Export/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent
card full off

# QA-FIL-023: F8 on the overlay cancels the export. `card slow` stretches the writing pass, so the three cancels land at the start, in pass 1 and in pass 2; each says EXPORT CANCELLED,
# leaves no file under the final name and no _o3save.tmp, and the next export gets the same number.
card slow 50000 2000 300
tap f1
wait 60
assert state overlay=EXPORT_PROGRESS
tap f8
wait 800
assert state overlay=NOTIFY msg=EXPORT_CANCELLED
assert file "Export/Small Song/Small Song_Song0001.wav" absent
assert file "Export/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent
tap f1
wait 500
assert state overlay=EXPORT_PROGRESS
tap f8
wait 800
assert state overlay=NOTIFY msg=EXPORT_CANCELLED
assert file "Export/Small Song/Small Song_Song0001.wav" absent
assert file "Export/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent
tap f1
wait 1500
assert state overlay=EXPORT_PROGRESS
tap f8
wait 800
assert state overlay=NOTIFY msg=EXPORT_CANCELLED
assert file "Export/Small Song/Small Song_Song0001.wav" absent
assert file "Export/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent

# The same export started again (the card's time back to normal) runs to the end and gets the same number, _0001.
card slow off
tap f1
wait 4000
assert state overlay=NOTIFY msg=~SAVED_EXPORT/SMALL_SONG/SMALL_SONG_SONG0001.WAV
assert file "Export/Small Song/Small Song_Song0001.wav" exists
assert file "Export/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent

# QA-FIL-039: PURGE (Shift + F7 twice) makes no call on the card: the project file is still the loaded one, byte for byte, with no .bak and no temporary. F4 SAVE then writes it and the
# old file becomes the .bak.
tap f7
wait 100
press shift
tap f7
release shift
assert state msg=~PURGE_1_UNUSED_INSTRUMENT[?]
press shift
tap f7
release shift
wait 100
assert state msg=~PURGED_1_INSTRUMENT
assert file "Projects/Small Song/project.o3pj" sha=fe075d31e2849cf6cb81a0bb157e1d748d13ed9c7c9141d98119b51370dc74df
assert file "Projects/Small Song/project.o3pj.bak" absent
assert file "Projects/Small Song/_o3save.tmp" absent
tap f4
wait 1500
assert state msg=SAVE_SMALL_SONG_DONE
assert file "Projects/Small Song/project.o3pj.bak" sha=fe075d31e2849cf6cb81a0bb157e1d748d13ed9c7c9141d98119b51370dc74df
